title: Mission Platform design-token override document
description: DTCG-style override document consumed by @mission-platform/vite-plugin-token-overrides. A nested tree of groups whose leaves are `{ $value, $description? }` tokens. `$`-prefixed keys are DTCG metadata and are ignored by the transform; every other leaf becomes a `--<prefix>-<path-joined-by-dashes>` custom property. The top-level groups and their keys mirror the overridable tokens defined by @mission-platform/tokens; unknown keys are still accepted (validated against the generic node schema) so forward-compatible and app-specific tokens keep working.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this JSON Schema, for editor validation/autocomplete.

$description.description: Human-readable description of the document (DTCG metadata, ignored by the transform).

border-width.description: Named border widths. Values are rem relative to the 14px root.

breakpoint.description: Seven-step responsive breakpoint min-width thresholds (mobile-first), anchored so that `lg` = 1920×1080 (Full HD). Consumed at compile time by the SCSS bp-up/bp-down/bp-between/bp-only mixins.

2xs.description: 0 — smallest phones; the mobile-first base, always matches.

xs.description: 480px — large phones / small phones in landscape.

lg.description: 1920px — Full HD (1920×1080) desktops; the design anchor.

color.description: Primitive colour swatches in OKLab: the absolute black/white anchors, two named base/primary helpers, and the 10-/11-step hue ramps (50 = lightest, 900/950 = darkest). These are raw values — components consume the semantic theme tokens (theme-light/theme-dark.tokens.json), not these directly.

primary-light.description: Near-white tint used as a light on-primary / primary surface helper.

primary-dark.description: Mid-tone neutral used as a primary helper on dark surfaces.

neutral.description: Greyscale ramp — surfaces, borders and text in both themes.

primary.description: Brand violet ramp — the primary action / accent colour.

cyan.description: Cyan/teal ramp — the secondary accent; the 950 stop is the dark-theme background base.

error.description: Red ramp — error status (mirrors the danger hue).

critical.description: Deep red/orange ramp — critical severity, above error.

surface.description: Theme surface & border primitives that fall outside the hue ramps: the light alternating surface plus the dark teal surface/border steps derived from the #111D1C (color.cyan.950) dark base.

light-alt.description: #e4e7ea — light theme alternating surface (slightly darker than the base).

dark-alt.description: #1a2827 — dark theme alternating surface (slightly lighter than the base).

dark.description: #172423 — dark theme raised surface / muted background.

dark-sunken.description: #0b1413 — dark theme sunken surface (wells, inset code).

scrim.description: Translucent black/white overlay primitives for scrims, loading overlays and skeleton shimmer. The numeric suffix is the alpha percentage.

black-40.description: Black at 40% — soft scrim / dark loading overlay.

black-50.description: Black at 50% — default scrim (light) / soft scrim (dark).

white-8.description: White at 8% — dark theme skeleton shimmer highlight.

white-40.description: White at 40% — light theme skeleton shimmer highlight.

white-70.description: White at 70% — light theme loading overlay.

duration.description: Transition/animation duration scale, from fast press-feedback to slow enter/exit. The default UI transition is `fast` (150ms).

fast.description: 150ms — the default UI transition (colour, border, shadow, opacity).

easing.description: Named easing (timing-function) curves. `standard` is the default UI easing.

font.description: Font primitives: family stacks, the modular size scale and the named weight steps.

family.description: Font-family stacks. The first entry is the brand face; the rest are progressive system fallbacks.

sans.description: Primary sans-serif stack — Comfortaa is the brand UI/body face, falling back to Inter then the system sans.

mono.description: Primary monospace stack — Datatype is the brand code face, falling back to JetBrains Mono / Fira Code then the system mono.

size.description: Modular font-size scale (base + 2xs → 5xl) consumed by the composite typography variants. The `base` step is the absolute root font-size; every other step is rem relative to it.

base.description: 14px — the root font-size; all rem values in this scale are relative to it.

md.description: 14px — default body copy / base font size.

weight.description: Named font-weight steps (400 → 700) covering the supported Comfortaa/Datatype axes.

letter-spacing.description: Letter-spacing (tracking) steps in em, from tightened headings to widely-tracked overlines.

line-height.description: Unitless line-height (leading) ratios, from dense headings to loose long-form copy.

radius.description: Border-radius scale from square (none) to fully rounded (full = pill/circle). Values are rem relative to the 14px root.

full.description: 9999px — pills, circular avatars/badges (sentinel value, intentionally px).

shadow.description: Elevation drop-shadow scale (plus inner and focus-ring shadows). Offsets/blur/spread are rem relative to the 14px root; focus rings use the brand/danger colours at 30% alpha.

focus-primary.description: Primary focus ring — keyboard focus on brand controls.

focus-danger.description: Danger focus ring — keyboard focus on destructive controls.

size.description: Unified component size scale (2xs → 2xl) covering font, padding, gap, radius, icon, shadow, leading, height and width. Each subgroup is one facet of a component at a given size step, so a `sm` button reads its font, padding, radius, etc. from the matching `sm` key across these subgroups.

font.description: Per-size component font-size (text within a sized control).

leading.description: Per-size line-height (unitless) for text within a sized control.

pad-block.description: Per-size block (top/bottom) padding for sized controls.

pad-inline.description: Per-size inline (left/right) padding for sized controls.

gap.description: Per-size internal gap between elements (e.g. icon-to-label) in sized controls; also reused as the margin scale.

radius.description: Per-size corner radius for sized controls.

icon.description: Per-size icon dimension (square) for sized controls.

shadow.description: Per-size elevation shadow (rem-based mirror of the absolute shadow scale) for sized surfaces.

height.description: Per-size control height (e.g. button / input height).

width.description: Per-size container/overlay max-width (e.g. modal width); 2xs/xs fall back to full viewport width.

spacing.description: Spacing scale for margin, padding and gap. The numeric keys are an ~0.286rem (4px) base unit step; the named `2xs … 2xl` keys are the canonical t-shirt scale used by the components' `padding`/`margin`/`gap` props. All rem values are relative to the 14px root.

2xs.description: ≈4px — t-shirt 2xs; canonical smallest padding/margin step (mirrors spacing.1).

label.description: Label — form labels, table headers, navigation items.

z-index.description: Named stacking levels, ascending. Use these instead of magic numbers so overlapping surfaces layer predictably.

raised.description: 1 — slightly raised in-flow elements (e.g. hovered cells).

overlay.description: 1200 — scrims / backdrops behind dialogs and drawers.

popover.description: 1400 — popovers and menus that must sit above modals.

lightDarkValue.description: A scheme-aware value that differs between the light and dark colour schemes. Emitted as `light-dark(<light>, <dark>)`.

light.description: The value used under the light colour scheme.

dark.description: The value used under the dark colour scheme.

overrideValue.description: A single override `$value` — a scalar (hex, rem, shadow list, font stack, number) emitted verbatim, or a scheme-aware `{ light, dark }` pair.

typographyValue.description: A composite DTCG `typography` `$value` — the sub-properties of a typography style. Values may be literals or `{token.path}` aliases.

lineHeight.description: Line height — a dimension or a unitless multiplier.

token.description: A DTCG-style override leaf token, identified by the presence of a `$value`.

$description.description: Optional description, emitted as a comment above the generated declaration.

typographyToken.description: A composite typography leaf token: a `$value` object of typography sub-properties.

$description.description: Optional description, emitted as a comment above the generated declaration.

group.description: A group node: nested groups and/or tokens, plus optional `$`-prefixed DTCG metadata.

$description.description: Optional group description (DTCG metadata, ignored by the transform).

node.description: Either a leaf token (has a `$value`) or a nested group of further nodes.
